jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.



At Relay, product management is about outcomes, not outputs. We start with real customer problems and build solutions that move the needle for SMBs, and for our business. Our team pairs long-term vision with rapid iteration. We believe that trust is a product feature, and that usability, reliability, and polish aren’t afterthoughts, they’re core to how we earn the confidence of business owners.

Every launch is measured, every release is a chance to learn, and we prioritize relentlessly so we can focus on what matters most. Above all, we never compromise on customer empathy or product craft.



Why this role matters

Many small businesses walk a constant cashflow tightrope, and the average SMB has just 27 days of cash on hand. They’re juggling payroll, inventory, contractor payments, and everyday expenses, all while trying to carve out resources to invest in growth. Product Managers at Relay play a central role in solving these problems by building financial products that are simple, intuitive, and impactful.

As Senior Product Manager, you’ll lead a major product area from end-to-end (e.g. core banking, risk, AI Insights, payroll etc). You’ll take new products and features from zero to one, scale existing ones, and directly impact how thousands of entrepreneurs run their businesses.

In your first year, you might:

 - Launch and iterate on high priority products ensuring the experiences are simple, intuitive, and trustworthy.

 - Improve customer outcomes by driving integrations with banking, accounting, or payment platforms.

 - Collaborate with Risk, Data, and Operations to ensure Relay’s products are reliable, secure, and insight-driven.

 - Build narratives and roadmaps that align stakeholders, clarify priorities, and inspire confidence, even in the face of ambiguity.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, and CX to deliver successful launches and drive adoption among SMB customers.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Own impactful products end-to-end: define the vision, set the roadmap, and deliver high-impact outcomes shaping how SMBs understand, manage, and spend their money.

 - Treat your product like a business: define and track KPIs, monitor performance, and make decisions rooted in data, customer insights, and company goals.

 - Ship high-quality products from ideation to launch: partner closely with design and engineering as part of a leadership trifecta, raising the bar for usability, craft, and polish.

 - Build and tell the story for your product: create clear narratives that inspire leadership, cross-functional partners, and customers; even in ambiguous situations.

 - Stay deeply connected to SMB customers: immerse yourself in their workflows and pain points, ensuring we’re solving meaningful problems and delivering products that feel both intuitive and delightful.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure smooth go-to-market launches and strong adoption.

 - Partner externally and internally: navigate and evaluate strategic partners while working across Relay as we grow our product offerings and build new capabilities.

 - Champion product culture at Relay: bring curiosity, ownership, and a high bar for quality that elevates both the product team as a whole.



Who You Are

 - At least five years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping and owning products at scale

 - Proven ability to take ownership of a product area and influence broader strategy.

 - Strong data competency with the ability to self-serve metrics and write basic SQL queries to support decision making

 - Excellent storytelling and communication skills: you bring clarity and inspire conviction across engineering, design, and business stakeholders.

 - Experience working closely with engineering and design as part of a leadership trifecta to deliver polished, high-quality experiences

 - Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure effective launches and adoption

 - Comfort working in ambiguous environments while bringing structure and clarity where needed

 - Experimental & curious in your approach to product management (i.e. tooling, processes etc)

Bonus Points

 - Have experience in fintech products.

 - You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale

 - You have experience working in a fintech startup

 - Are familiar with risk/fraud tools or credit underwriting frameworks.



The Interview Process

 - Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meets video call with a member of our Talent team

 - Stage 2: A 45-minute Product Deep Dive interview with the hiring manager

 - Stage 3: A 1-hour case study panel interview - a take home case study assignment will form the basis of this discussion

 - Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our leadership team

Our Compensation Approach

At Relay, we believe Relayers should feel valued for the impact they have on our mission and growth. So we pay fairly and transparently. The annual salary range for this role is $162,000 CAD to $198,000 CAD.

We pay for impact and aren’t tied to yearly reviews. As your contributions to Relay’s mission scale, so do your rewards. Most new Relayers will join at the impactful level, which for this role is $180,000 CAD per year. The range represents the potential for impact within the role, from developing to having an outsized impact.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub https://www.notion.so/Candidate-Hub-1c7da8b7f88580a893f7d7c7852b064e?pvs=21.

 - You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

 - You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

 - You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

 - You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself. 

 - You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

 - You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. Our team pairs long-term vision with rapid iteration. Why this role matters

Signing up for a business bank account is the easy part. The hard part is the distance between "account opened" and "this is where I run my business." That distance is where most SMBs quietly stall; the first deposit that never lands, the payroll still running out of the old account, the bookkeeper who was never invited in. Every business owner who doesn't cross it stays on the cashflow tightrope we exist to get them off of.

As Senior Product Manager, Growth (Activation), you own that crossing. You'll own the journey from first login to funded, transacting, habitual use of Relay — and the systems, experiments, and in-product moments that get customers there faster and in greater numbers. This is a metrics-owning role: you'll be accountable for activation rate, time-to-first-deposit, and depth of product adoption in the first 90 days, and for the revenue those unlock.



In your first year, you might:

 - Rebuild the post-signup experience so a new owner reaches their first funded transaction in days, not weeks

 - Diagnose where and why customers drop between account approval, funding, and first payment, then ship the sequenced interventions that close those gaps

 - Stand up the experimentation and lifecycle infrastructure that lets Relay run activation tests continuously rather than one-off

 - Drive adoption of the products that make Relay sticky (multiple accounts, cards, bill pay, accounting integrations) by getting them in front of the right owner at the right moment

 - Partner with Risk and Operations so that friction we add for good reasons (KYC, fraud controls) costs us as few good customers as possible

 - Build the narrative and roadmap that aligns leadership, Marketing, and CX around a shared definition of an activated customer



What you'll be doing:

 - Own activation end-to-end: define the vision, set the roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements to how quickly and completely SMBs start running their money through Relay

 - Treat activation like a business: define the activation metric that actually predicts retention and revenue, instrument it, monitor it, and make decisions rooted in data and customer insight

 - Run a real experiment engine: form hypotheses, design tests, read results honestly, and kill what doesn't work, while knowing when a problem calls for a rebuild rather than an A/B test

 - Ship high-quality product from ideation to launch: partner closely with design and engineering as part of a leadership trifecta, raising the bar for usability, craft, and polish. Onboarding copy and empty states are your job, not someone else's

 - Work across the whole first-run surface: in-product experiences, lifecycle messaging, and the handoffs between Marketing, Sales, and CX that make or break a new customer's first month

 - Stay deeply connected to SMB customers: watch real owners set up their accounts, understand what makes them hesitate to move their money, and design for the trust that earns

 - Build and tell the story: create clear narratives that inspire leadership and cross-functional partners, even in ambiguous situations

 - Champion product culture at Relay: bring curiosity, ownership, and a high bar for quality that elevates the product team as a whole



Who you are

 - At least five years of product management experience, with a track record of owning and materially moving a funnel or lifecycle metric

 - Direct experience with activation, onboarding, or early-lifecycle work in a product-led business

 - Strong data competency: you self-serve your metrics, write your own SQL, and can tell a real signal from a noisy test

 - Fluent in experimentation. You know what your infrastructure can and can't support, and you're rigorous about what counts as a win

 - Excellent storytelling and communication skills: you bring clarity and inspire conviction across engineering, design, and business stakeholders

 - Experience working closely with engineering and design as part of a leadership trifecta to deliver polished, high-quality experiences

 - Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure effective launches and adoption

 - Comfort working in ambiguous environments while bringing structure and clarity where needed

 - A hands-on operator's instinct. You're as comfortable in the details of a UX flow or a lifecycle trigger as in a roadmap review



Bonus points

 - You've worked on activation in fintech, where compliance, funding, and risk controls sit directly in the path of the customer journey

 - You've joined a company at its early stages and seen it through scale

 - You're familiar with risk/fraud tools or KYC/onboarding frameworks and how to optimize around them without weakening them

 - You've built lifecycle or CRM systems in partnership with a marketing team

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.


We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our fast-growing Product Marketing team. In this role, you’ll sit at the center of product, marketing, and growth – driving strategy, informing roadmap, and unlocking adoption through creative and strategic launches, analysis, customer insights, and storytelling.

 

This is an ideal role for a PMM who is hungry for impact, strategically minded, and passionate about bringing fintech products to market. You'll own positioning, partner with product to influence what we build, and work across teams to ensure our product drives real customer value and sustained growth. From early ideation to product launch, you’ll partner with cross-functional teams to shape positioning and messaging, lead go-to-market strategies, set pricing and packaging, and uncover insights through market research and competitive intelligence. You won't just support GTM – you’ll help shape it, with a deep focus on experimentation, conversion, and storytelling that connects users to product value.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

 - Roadmap & Strategy Partnership: Serve as a key voice of the customer to inform product roadmap and prioritization. Collaborate closely with Product Management and Brand/Design to align product strategy with market opportunities and growth potential

 - Adoption & Growth Strategy: Own the strategy and execution of programs that drive product adoption, activation, and retention for your product line. Identify friction points in the user journey and partner with Product, Growth, and Data to experiment, test and iterate on improvements

 - Go-to-Market Planning: Develop and own go-to-market strategies for new features, product launches, and key initiatives across our product lines. Validate launches are informed by customer needs, and GTM efforts are tied to measurable business outcomes

 - Customer & Competitive Insights: Lead research efforts to understand user needs, use cases, and market trends. Translate customer insights into positioning and messaging that resonate with users, refining it across the customer journey and ensuring consistent delivery across all marketing channels

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with Product, Data, Brand/Design, Demand Generation, Growth, Sales, and Partnerships to message on product marketing goals, share insights, and create cohesive customer experiences

 - Project Management: Product launches cross-functionally to hit targets and launch and enable internal teams on time

 

Who You Are

 - You have 5+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in an early-stage B2B or B2B2C company, with experience supporting SMBs

 - You have a proven track record of launching products or features, driving adoption, and delivering tangible business and customer outcomes

 - You’re a data-driven storyteller, skilled at crafting compelling narratives that resonate with and influence stakeholders and customers alike based on metrics

 - You’re a customer champion – you engage deeply with customers and translate those insights into messaging and positioning that resonates

 - You take pride in being a trusted voice of the customer when they’re not in the room

 - You have exceptional project management skills, leading and influencing cross-functional stakeholders to act with urgency and meet objectives and deadlines

 - You’re metrics-driven – you define KPIs, create reporting requirements, and partner with the Data team to produce high-quality reports that track progress

 - You excel in fast-paced environments, have a bias for action, and demonstrate a strong ownership mindset


The Interview Process

 - Stage 1: A 30-minute Google Meet video call with a member of the Talent team

 - Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet video call with the Head of Product Marketing

 - Stage 3: A take-home case study followed by a 60-minute Google Meet video call with our team

 - Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of the Leadership team

 

Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

 

The annual salary range for this role is $139,500 CAD to $170,500 CAD.

 

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $155,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

 

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. As Senior Product Manager, you’ll lead a major product area from end-to-end (e.g. core banking, risk, AI Insights, payroll etc). You’ll take new products and features from zero to one, scale existing ones, and directly impact how thousands of entrepreneurs run their businesses.

In your first year, you might:

 - Launch and iterate on high priority products ensuring the experiences are simple, intuitive, and trustworthy.

 - Improve customer outcomes by driving integrations with banking, accounting, or payment platforms.

 - Collaborate with Risk, Data, and Operations to ensure Relay’s products are reliable, secure, and insight-driven.

 - Build narratives and roadmaps that align stakeholders, clarify priorities, and inspire confidence, even in the face of ambiguity.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, and CX to deliver successful launches and drive adoption among SMB customers.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Own impactful products end-to-end: define the vision, set the roadmap, and deliver high-impact outcomes shaping how SMBs understand, manage, and spend their money.

 - Treat your product like a business: define and track KPIs, monitor performance, and make decisions rooted in data, customer insights, and company goals.

 - Ship high-quality products from ideation to launch: partner closely with design and engineering as part of a leadership trifecta, raising the bar for usability, craft, and polish.

 - Build and tell the story for your product: create clear narratives that inspire leadership, cross-functional partners, and customers; even in ambiguous situations.

 - Stay deeply connected to SMB customers: immerse yourself in their workflows and pain points, ensuring we’re solving meaningful problems and delivering products that feel both intuitive and delightful.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure smooth go-to-market launches and strong adoption.

 - Partner externally and internally: navigate and evaluate strategic partners while working across Relay as we grow our product offerings and build new capabilities.

 - Champion product culture at Relay: bring curiosity, ownership, and a high bar for quality that elevates both the product team as a whole.



Who You Are

 - At least five years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping and owning products at scale

 - Proven ability to take ownership of a product area and influence broader strategy.

 - Strong data competency with the ability to self-serve metrics and write basic SQL queries to support decision making

 - Excellent storytelling and communication skills: you bring clarity and inspire conviction across engineering, design, and business stakeholders.

 - Experience working closely with engineering and design as part of a leadership trifecta to deliver polished, high-quality experiences

 - Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams to ensure effective launches and adoption

 - Comfort working in ambiguous environments while bringing structure and clarity where needed

 - Experimental & curious in your approach to product management (i.e. tooling, processes etc)

Bonus Points

 - Have experience in fintech products.

 - You’ve joined a company at its early stages and have seen it through scale

 - You have experience working in a fintech startup

 - Are familiar with risk/fraud tools or credit underwriting frameworks.



The Interview Process

 - Stage 1: A 45-minute Google Meets video call with a member of our Talent team

 - Stage 2: A 45-minute Product Deep Dive interview with the hiring manager

 - Stage 3: A 1-hour case study panel interview - a take home case study assignment will form the basis of this discussion

 - Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of our leadership team

Our Compensation Approach

At Relay, we believe Relayers should feel valued for the impact they have on our mission and growth. So we pay fairly and transparently. The annual salary range for this role is $189,000 USD to $231,000 USD.

We pay for impact and aren’t tied to yearly reviews. As your contributions to Relay’s mission scale, so do your rewards. Most new Relayers will join at the impactful level, which for this role is $210,000 USD per year. The range represents the potential for impact within the role, from developing to having an outsized impact.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub https://www.notion.so/Candidate-Hub-1c7da8b7f88580a893f7d7c7852b064e?pvs=21.



Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You 

 - You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

 - You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

 - You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

 - You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

 - You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself. 

 - You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

 - You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

 - Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.



Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.



We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Product-Led Growth to join our fast-growing Product Marketing team. This is a PMM role with a clear line to revenue through usage-based pricing, at a company betting big on product-led growth as its next chapter. Most of our customers never talk to a salesperson — they discover Relay's value on their own, inside the product. That means the product itself has to do the selling, and you'll be the one defining how it does: reading customer behavior, spotting the moments where value is obvious, and building the paths and incentives that turn that value into revenue.

This is an ideal role for a PMM who thinks like a product person as much as a marketer, and wants direct, measurable influence on revenue. You know product-led growth, and you love to write. You'll bring the go-to-market lens to product decisions on usage-based pricing — working closely with Product Management and Product Design to create Relay's path to monetization.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Own the monetization moments. Paywalls, upgrade prompts, plan comparison, and trial messaging. Make the case for paying when the value is most obvious, without eroding trust.

 - Bring the GTM lens to product decisions. You know the SMB owner, the competitive set, and the value story. Push that understanding upstream into what gets built, not just how it's described. Partner closely with Product Management and Marketing to align strategy with market opportunity and growth potential.

 - Keep the story consistent. The ad, the pricing page, the first screen after signup, and the week-three lifecycle email should tell one story. You define the story and partner with Brand, Demand Gen, and Lifecycle to create a cohesive experience.

 - Lead customer and competitive insight. Understand user needs and market trends. Translate insight into positioning and messaging that stays consistent across the customer journey.

 - Run the experiments. Size the opportunity, write the variants, call the test, ship the winner, kill the loser. Partner with Data to instrument what matters and report honestly, including the losses.

 - Work inside a regulated product. Money movement, card spend, and balance thresholds carry real compliance obligations.  Bring Legal and Compliance in early and treat their constraints as design inputs, not last-minute roadblocks.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 3+ years of product marketing or growth marketing. Bonus points for exposure to UX, content design, or technical writing

 - Experience with product-led growth (PLG) motions

 - Experience in fintech, startups, and/or the SMB space

 - Strong experimentation skills — you can size, run, and call a test

 - Customer champion – you engage deeply with customers and translate those insights into messaging and positioning that resonates

 - Stage 4: A 45-minute in-person interview with a member of the Leadership team

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.
